memory_budget.reason: static arrays fit well below 2 GB, but the load/tocsc/file-buffer/NumPy overhead peak is not measured; no credible measured upper bound
memory_budget.recommendation_2GB: keep 2 GB for the benchmark; if measured peak exceeds 2 GB -> stop/INCONCLUSIVE; do not auto-raise the cap

none_only_plan.plan: one full-brain init + 25 resets; save KC/MBON arrays; NO eligibility computation
none_only_plan.static_extrapolation_note: nnz ratio 7.207 is NOT a measured time/memory multiplier; cache/fired-count/fixed overhead differ
none_only_plan.eligibility: not needed for the none-only baseline comparison

rng_audit.implementation: FlyBrain.reset(seed) sets self.rng=default_rng(seed); each step draws rng.random((N,B))
rng_audit.comparison_type: between-model comparison with a shared seed label; NOT a noise-paired comparison
rng_audit.statistical_limitation: common-bodyId neurons occupy different positions and the RNG stream advances by N draws/step, so the per-neuron noise is not aligned
rng_audit.can_only_interpret_as: overall truncation condition, not a specific external inhibition/excitation cause

fly64_code_values.source: fly64/model.py mentioned in flybrain/brain.py docstring; code values

phase2_provenance.why: code defaults / author hand-set values and a code-to-code comparison are not independently published physiological calibrations; 'literature mentioned a similar model' != validated params

p11_0_dz_errata.p11_0_dz_definition: mean(per-cell means) / sd(per-cell means) across 320 cells
p11_0_dz_errata.mislabel: P11-0 dz is a cross-cell standardized mean, NOT a paired-by-seed Cohen's dz; do not conflate the two

why_phase1_execution_no_go: written authorization for the 25-seed experiment not granted
